records.reason: Recurrent Transformer tiling reduces HBM traffic to N log N and may lower KV memory/inference latency.

records.title: Geometry-Guided 3D Visual Token Pruning for Video-Language Models
records.reason: Geo3DPruner removes redundant visual tokens in video-language inference, pruning 90% while retaining over 90% performance.

records.title: DiffPrune: differentiable information throttling for token pruning in vision-language models
records.reason: DiffPrune visual-token pruning reports 2.85x faster VLM LLM-prefill at near-baseline accuracy.

records.title: CLIP Tricks You: Training-free Token Pruning for Efficient Pixel Grounding in Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: LiteLVLM prunes visual tokens for pixel-grounding inference and reports speed/memory gains.

records.title: Smooth Reading: Bridging the Gap of Recurrent LLM to Self-Attention LLM on Long-Context Tasks
records.reason: Smooth Reading chunks recurrent-LLM long-context inference and reports 2x speedup at 64k.

records.title: AdaPTwin: Low-Cost Adaptive Compression of Product Twins in Transformers
records.reason: AdaPTwin compresses Whisper attention matrices up to 45% with under 2% WER rise; concrete transformer inference compression, evaluated in ASR.

records.title: Glance2Gaze: Efficient Vision-Language Models from Glance Fusion to Gaze Compression
records.reason: Official NeurIPS abstract describes query-guided visual-token compression with equal/lower VLM computation cost.

records.title: ConsensusDrop: Fusing Visual and Cross-Modal Saliency for Efficient Vision Language Models
records.reason: ConsensusDrop fuses visual and cross-modal saliency to prune/merge tokens, reducing VLM TTFT and KV footprint.
